metadata.name: FileBrowser Quantum v2
metadata.description: FileBrowser Quantum 2.0 file manager. This is a new app, separate from FileBrowser Quantum 1.5.8. v2 stores users and shares in SQLite and refuses to start while a v1 database.db file is still in the data directory. Do not attach the 1.5.8 data volume. A fresh install prints a one-time admin password in the container logs.
metadata.author: BigBearCommunity

volumes.description: SQLite database and configuration. Do not mount a v1 data directory here.

ports.description: Web UI (host port 8701 so it does not collide with FileBrowser Quantum 1.5.8 on 8700)

before_install.en_us:
NEW APP - FILEBROWSER QUANTUM V2

This is a NEW app, separate from 'filebrowser-quantum' (1.5.8-stable). Do not treat the install as an upgrade of an existing 1.5.8 stack.

FOR NEW USERS:
- Install this app for a new FileBrowser Quantum 2 deployment
- Web UI is on host port 8701. On Umbrel the published port is 10701
- The first start generates an admin password and prints it once in the container logs. The username is admin. v2 does not keep the old admin/admin password
- Change that password at the first login
- Files you want to browse belong in the filebrowser-quantum-v2_srv volume, mounted at /srv

FOR FILEBROWSER QUANTUM 1.5.8 USERS:
- Do NOT uninstall the existing 'filebrowser-quantum' app
- Do NOT point this app at the 1.5.8 data volume. v2 refuses to start while database.db is still named database.db
- v2 replaces BoltDB with SQLite. Config keys also move, including FILEBROWSER_DATABASE to FILEBROWSER_DATABASE_PATH
- Stop 1.5.8, copy database.db somewhere safe, rename the copy to database.db.old, convert config.yaml, and set server.database.migrateFrom before starting v2 against that copy
- Keep 1.5.8 until you have logged in on v2 and checked users, shares, and sidebar links

Migration: https://filebrowserquantum.com/en/docs/getting-started/v2/migration/
